playstyle.identity: Fiora is a duelist who hits vitals for percent max health true damage. She's one of the best split-pushers and 1v1ers in the game.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive reveals vitals on enemies (hit for true damage and speed). Q dashes and prioritizes vitals. W parries everything and stuns if it blocks CC. E slows then crits. R reveals all 4 vitals - proc all 4 for massive healing zone. Dance around enemies hitting vitals.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Fiora spikes at level 6 with her vital ultimate. Ravenous Hydra and Divine Sunderer scale her. She's a late-game 1v1 monster.

weaknesses: Needs vitals to be positioned well

passive.name: Duelist's Dance
passive.summary: Reveals vitals on enemies; hitting them deals true damage and heals.
passive.details: Enemy champions periodically reveal a vital. Striking the vital deals percent max health true damage, heals Fiora, and grants movement speed.

abilities.name: Lunge
abilities.summary: Dash and stab; prioritizes vitals and refunds cooldown.
abilities.details: Fiora lunges in a direction and stabs a nearby enemy. Prioritizes vitals and champions. If it hits, the cooldown is partially refunded.

abilities.name: Riposte
abilities.summary: Parry all damage and CC; stuns if it blocks an immobilizing effect.
abilities.details: Fiora parries all damage and debuffs for a moment, then stabs dealing damage and slowing. If she parries an immobilizing effect, the enemy is stunned instead.

abilities.name: Bladework
abilities.summary: Next two autos: first slows, second critically strikes.
abilities.details: Fiora empowers her next two auto attacks. The first slows the target; the second is guaranteed to critically strike.

abilities.name: Grand Challenge
abilities.summary: Reveal all 4 vitals; hitting all creates a healing zone.
abilities.details: Fiora reveals all four vitals on an enemy champion. Hitting all four (or if the target dies) creates a large healing zone for Fiora and allies.
